name: B10-0359/2026 (S&D) – The threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the war in Sudan, and it asks the European Union to do more: push the warring sides to stop attacks on civilians and lift the siege of El-Obeid, punish countries that send weapons, give more aid, and consider putting the Rapid Support Forces on the EU's terrorist list.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests to the EU, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Sudan's warring sides, outside arms suppliers, and civilians needing aid.
- **What happens next:** The EU's member governments decide whether to act on these requests.
